reproducibility_gaps: No repository license was identified at the pinned snapshot.
No dependency manifest or explicit installation procedure is present; README requirements specify Python and PyTorch versions but leave numpy unpinned.
Repository YAMLs embed provider-local absolute data paths that require manual remapping to the externally documented dataset.
When --seed is omitted, train_pino.py generates a random seed rather than providing a repository-default reproducibility seed.
Runtime hardware provenance and a reconstructable acceptance environment are not documented.
train_pino.py includes a CPU fallback but then unconditionally queries CUDA device properties, creating a source-level portability defect.

The README-cited SGS-coefficient-learning example uses 31 total iterations while the principal DHIT physics-informed configuration uses 30001; the short setting is not explained in the bounded documentation.
notes: R1 reflects a pinned, richly documented scientific workflow with explicit source/configuration evidence, but R2 is blocked by absent installation documentation and incomplete environment reconstruction.
